flavour.finding: Correct Takagi/charged-lepton-basis extraction gives a good underconstrained natural-v_R benchmark, but no chi2<30 point in the current fixed-v_R=v_S profile. The earlier viable single-scale claim was an invalid diagonalization artifact.

thresholds.two_loop_scope: anchor content without spectators; gauge-only MV; tree-level matching

two_loop_unavailable.alpha_inv_GUT_after_spectators: UNAVAILABLE: no perturbative two-loop gauge unification exists with the contract spectators 5 x (16 + 16bar) at M_s = M_I (three independent two-loop codes agree; reproduced by build_report()['spectator_two_loop_probe']). The one-loop additive shift -(40/3)/(2 pi) ln(M_GUT/M_s) does not carry over to two loops because the spectators' two-loop b_ij are non-universal.

two_loop_unavailable.continuous_spin10: UNAVAILABLE: continuous two-loop Spin(10) running above M_GUT needs the contract's two-loop spectator-corrected alpha_GUT at M_GUT as its initial condition, and none exists (no perturbative two-loop gauge unification with 5 x (16 + 16bar) at M_s = M_I; see alpha_inv_GUT_after_spectators). Neither the one-loop 16.81 nor the no-spectator two-loop anchor 33.47 is that matching condition. The former x1.1 heavy-beta factor was not two-loop running and has been removed.

bottom_line: External next steps are computed. The 10+126 fit works at a natural v_R, but the corrected v_R=v_S profile is not viable. Continuous one-loop thresholds reject the alpha=1/40 reset; the two-loop spectator-corrected coupling is UNAVAILABLE (no perturbative two-loop unification at the benchmark). A MADMAX-like forecast can reach the 37 GHz coupling in software — that is not a dark-matter discovery.
